description: This Java class defines a test utility for exporting a database schema to an SQL script using Hibernate and JUnit. It extends a core test case and utilizes Spring's dependency injection to access the EntityManagerFactory, then creates a schema export command.

classes.name: ExportSchema
classes.description: A JUnit test class for exporting Hibernate-managed database schema to a SQL file.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Generates a SQL schema script from annotated entities and writes it to a file.
